scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Visually Impaired Advocates
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native and resident of Kerala
Applicant must be a visually impaired Advocate
Applicant must be practicing in any one or more Courts in Kerala
benefits_summary: An ex‑gratia non‑recurring grant of ₹3500 for books and provisional suits, plus a monthly reader's allowance of ₹5000 for ten years.
